name: Ip2_FrictMat_FrictMat_CapillaryMindlinPhysDelaunay
description: Variant of Ip2_(matType)_(matType)_(iPhysType) to be used with CapillarityEngine.

attributes.name: computeDefault
attributes.description: bool to assign the default value of computeBridge.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Coefficient to determine the plastic bending moment

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: Surface energy parameter [J/m^2] per each unit contact surface, to derive DMT formulation from HM

attributes.name: krot
attributes.description: Rotational stiffness for moment contact law

attributes.name: ktwist
attributes.description: Torsional stiffness for moment contact law

attributes.name: vn
attributes.description: Impact velocity corresponding to the en value to calculate the dissipative constant $An$ used in the viscous damping model of [Mueller2011]_.
